phase: P1 baseline ladder, development window only (docs/prereg/01 section 2)

windows.rule: docs/prereg/07 section 2: Level-A seasons s1..sN; burn-in s1..s3 never scored; development s4..s(N-2); lockbox s(N-1), sN sealed
windows.level_a_seasons: 1997-2022 (26, nba_stats; all pass the 95% minutes-coverage rule)

forecast_protocol.forecast_points: every scheduled tip in the window as known at chunk start - 1 day (BacktestSpec semantics, run in 7-day chunks because GAME v1 becomes known at tip - 7 d)
phases_excluded: preseason (docs/prereg/07 section 4: excluded from scoring; remains an input through the as-of history)
forecast_protocol.refit: every forecast time (07 section 3, L1-L6 refit daily)

L2_grid.selection_rule: L2 for season s = the half-life with the lowest core CRPS (mode U, regular season) over the scored seasons strictly before s; for s = 2000 the burn-in seasons 1998-1999 are forecast for selection only and never reported. Rule fixed before any outcome was seen.

models.L3: MinutesRate(shrink=False) with the frozen implementation defaults (half_life=15, prior_strength_min=150); INJURY_REPORT absent (M1) so p_appear falls back to the player's own appearance history
models.implementation: frozen hoopslab.models.baselines via experiments/p1_ladder/models.py (shared per-view history cache; bit-identical, see check_shared_equals_vanilla.py)

scoring.primary: CRPS (exact integer form); core aggregate = equal-weight mean of per-target skills, mode U, regular season
diagnostic: randomised PIT: KS, dispersion ratio, coverage 50/80/95
upper-tail twCRPS at PTS 25, PRA 40, REB 10, AST 8
scoring.comparisons: each rung vs the immediately simpler rung and vs the best simpler rung; MPE 0.01 core CRPS skill (baseline_ladder.yaml default); Holm within the ladder family
strata_reported: low_sample (< 10 as-of appearances; X-L4-L3 note, P1 coverage gate)
role_change_alarm (X-L2-L1 note only; NO H6 interaction statistic is computed)

gates_P1: L1 >> L0 on every core target (expected 35-55%)
L3 >= L2 on MIN mode U
L4-plugin coverage80 in low_sample <= L4 coverage80
